fact: Among 125,474 patients initiating GLP-1 RAs, 46.5% of patients with type 2 diabetes and 64.8% without type 2 diabetes discontinued within 1 year.
fact_zh: 在125,474名开始使用GLP-1 RAs的患者中，有46.5%的2型糖尿病患者和64.8%的非2型糖尿病患者在1年内停药。
quote: 46.5% of patients with and 64.8% without type 2 diabetes discontinued within 1 year

fact: Among 125,474 patients initiating GLP-1 RAs, 47.3% of patients with type 2 diabetes and 36.3% without type 2 diabetes reinitiated a GLP-1 RA within 1 year.
fact_zh: 在125,474名开始使用GLP-1 RAs的患者中，有47.3%的2型糖尿病患者和36.3%的非2型糖尿病患者在1年内重新开始使用GLP-1 RA。
quote: 47.3% of patients with and 36.3% without type 2 diabetes subsequently reinitiated a GLP-1 RA within 1 year

fact: The overall discontinuation rate of GLP-1 RAs within 1 year was 53.6% (95% CI, 53.4%-53.9%).
fact_zh: GLP-1 RAs在1年内的总体停药率为53.6%（95% CI，53.4%-53.9%）。
quote: 53.6% (95% CI, 53.4%-53.9%) discontinued by 1 year

fact: The overall discontinuation rate of GLP-1 RAs within 2 years was 72.2% (95% CI, 71.9%-72.4%).
fact_zh: GLP-1 RAs在2年内的总体停药率为72.2%（95% CI，71.9%-72.4%）。
quote: 72.2% (95% CI, 71.9%-72.4%) discontinued by 2 years

fact: Patients with type 2 diabetes had a lower discontinuation rate (46.5% by 1 year and 64.1% by 2 years) compared to patients without type 2 diabetes (64.8% by 1 year and 84.4% by 2 years).
fact_zh: 与没有2型糖尿病的患者（1年内64.8%，2年内84.4%）相比，2型糖尿病患者的停药率更低（1年内46.5%，2年内64.1%）。

fact: Patients with type 2 diabetes who experienced a 1% weight loss had a 3.1% lower hazard of discontinuation compared to those without weight loss.
fact_zh: 与没有体重减轻的患者相比，2型糖尿病患者体重减轻1%的停药风险降低了3.1%。
quote: A 1% reduction in weight from baseline was associated with a 3.1% (95% CI, 2.9%-3.2%) lower hazard of discontinuation for patients with type 2 diabetes

fact: Patients without type 2 diabetes who experienced a 1% weight loss had a 3.3% lower hazard of discontinuation compared to those without weight loss.
fact_zh: 与没有体重减轻的患者相比，非2型糖尿病患者体重减轻1%的停药风险降低了3.3%。
quote: a 3.3% (95% CI, 3.2%-3.5%) lower hazard of discontinuation for patients without type 2 diabetes

fact: Patients with type 2 diabetes who experienced moderate or severe GI adverse events had a 38% higher hazard of discontinuation compared to those without such events.
fact_zh: 与没有此类事件的患者相比，2型糖尿病患者出现中度或重度胃肠道不良事件的停药风险增加了38%。

fact: Patients without type 2 diabetes who experienced moderate or severe GI adverse events had a 19% higher hazard of discontinuation compared to those without such events.
fact_zh: 与没有此类事件的患者相比，非2型糖尿病患者出现中度或重度胃肠道不良事件的停药风险增加了19%。

fact: Among 81,919 patients who discontinued their GLP-1 RA, 51.0% were included in reinitiation analyses.
fact_zh: 在81,919名停用GLP-1 RA的患者中，有51.0%被纳入重新开始使用分析。
quote: 41 792 (51.0%) were included in reinitiation analyses

fact: The overall reinitiation rate of GLP-1 RAs within 1 year was 47.3% for patients with type 2 diabetes and 36.3% for patients without type 2 diabetes.
fact_zh: 2型糖尿病患者在1年内重新开始使用GLP-1 RA的总体率为47.3%，非2型糖尿病患者为36.3%。
quote: 47.3% (95% CI, 46.6%-48.0%) of patients with type 2 diabetes and 36.3% (95% CI, 35.6%-37.0%) of patients without type 2 diabetes reinitiated a GLP-1 RA within 1 year

fact: The overall reinitiation rate of GLP-1 RAs within 2 years was 57.3% for patients with type 2 diabetes and 46.4% for patients without type 2 diabetes.
fact_zh: 2型糖尿病患者在2年内重新开始使用GLP-1 RA的总体率为57.3%，非2型糖尿病患者为46.4%。
quote: 57.3% (95% CI, 56.5%-58.1%) with type 2 diabetes and 46.4% (95% CI, 45.4%-47.4%) without type 2 diabetes reinitiated a GLP-1 RA within 2 years

fact: Patients with type 2 diabetes who experienced a 1% weight gain since discontinuation had a 2.3% higher hazard of reinitiation compared to those without weight gain.
fact_zh: 与没有体重增加的患者相比，2型糖尿病患者停药后体重增加1%的重新开始使用风险增加了2.3%。
quote: a 2.3% (95% CI, 1.9%-2.8%) increased hazard of reinitiation for patients with type 2 diabetes

fact: Patients without type 2 diabetes who experienced a 1% weight gain since discontinuation had a 2.8% higher hazard of reinitiation compared to those without weight gain.
fact_zh: 与没有体重增加的患者相比，非2型糖尿病患者停药后体重增加1%的重新开始使用风险增加了2.8%。
quote: a 2.8% (95% CI, 2.4%-3.2%) increased hazard of reinitiation for patients without type 2 diabetes

fact: Patients with type 2 diabetes who experienced moderate or severe GI adverse events during initial treatment had a 14% lower rate of reinitiation compared to those without such events.
fact_zh: 与没有此类事件的患者相比，2型糖尿病患者在初始治疗期间出现中度或重度胃肠道不良事件的重新开始使用率降低了14%。

fact: Patients without type 2 diabetes who experienced moderate or severe GI adverse events during initial treatment had a 18% lower rate of reinitiation compared to those without such events.
fact_zh: 与没有此类事件的患者相比，非2型糖尿病患者在初始治疗期间出现中度或重度胃肠道不良事件的重新开始使用率降低了18%。

fact: Patients aged 65 years or older were significantly less likely to reinitiate their GLP-1 RA compared to younger patients.
fact_zh: 与年轻患者相比，65岁或以上的患者更不可能重新开始使用GLP-1 RA。
quote: Those aged 65 years or older were significantly less likely to reinitiate their GLP-1 RA

fact: The overall population included 76,524 patients (61.0%) with type 2 diabetes and 48,950 patients (39.0%) without type 2 diabetes.
fact_zh: 总体人群包括76,524名（61.0%）2型糖尿病患者和48,950名（39.0%）非2型糖尿病患者。
quote: 76 524 patients (61.0%) with type 2 diabetes... 48 950 patients (39.0%) without type 2 diabetes

fact: The median BMI at baseline was 37.3 (IQR, 33.1-42.7), with 45,751 patients (36.5%) classified as having class 3 obesity (BMI ≥40).
fact_zh: 基线BMI的中位数为37.3（IQR，33.1-42.7），其中45,751名患者（36.5%）被归类为3级肥胖（BMI ≥40）。
quote: The median BMI at baseline was 37.3 (IQR, 33.1-42.7), with 45 751 patients (36.5%) classified as having class 3 obesity (BMI ≥40).

fact: Among patients with income information (105,841 [84.4%]), 52.2% of those with type 2 diabetes and 59.0% of those without type 2 diabetes had individual income exceeding $50,000.
fact_zh: 在有收入信息的患者中（105,841 [84.4%]），52.2%的2型糖尿病患者和59.0%的非2型糖尿病患者的个人收入超过5万美元。
quote: individual income exceeded $50 000 for 33 742 of 64 650 (52.2%) with type 2 diabetes and 24 291 of 41 191 (59.0%) without type 2 diabetes
